role: The short tag, type id 2: item damage values, PickupDelay-like timers, small counters in entity and item NBT.
scope_reason: Part of the NBT layer behind snapshots and digests.

members.name: func_150291_c
members.note: a cross-type read: NBTTagCompound.getByte/getShort/getInteger/getLong/getFloat/getDouble (and NBTTagList.func_150309_d/func_150308_e) call it only when the key holds a tag of this type but is read as another; the game reads every key with the type it wrote it (EntityLivingBase.readEntityFromNBT checks HealF/Health's type first) and a survival player writes no NBT of their own (no chat commands in the agent input; anvil, book_editing and sign_editing are off). The same-type getter runs in every recording
